en.headline: 19 own commits plus 24 automated commits
en.summary: **19 own commits** were recorded across `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, plus 24 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, work expanded the knowledge base with the Console object model, BSK daemon troubleshooting and window behavior, BrowserSkill shortcuts, and Hunyuan 4 pelican-bike evaluation results and comparisons. It also archived evaluation artifacts and prompt text, clarified that `AGENTS.md` is the single convention landing point, removed conversational and first-person wording, and corrected the LSP description with the `experimental.todo` switch for `todowrite`. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, the gallery became a GitHub Pages homepage with bilingual, light/dark, and copy-command features driven by Markdown, alongside 12 Xiaohongshu-style covers and a browsable gallery page. `antfu` replied to two listing requests in `vercel-labs/skills`, explaining that `skills.sh` indexes skills automatically when they are installed with `npx skills add` and telemetry is enabled, then closed issue #2298 for `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` and issue #2297 for `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`.

zh.headline: 19 次本人提交，另有 24 次自动提交
zh.summary: 当天在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 和 `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 共完成 **19 次本人提交**，另有 24 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的知识库新增 Console 对象模型、BSK daemon 启动与扩展连接排查、BSK 新开窗口原因、BrowserSkill 五个快捷功能，以及混元 4 版鹈鹕骑车实测与四版对比；同时归档评测产物和提示词原文，明确 `AGENTS.md` 为约定唯一落点，去除对话式自省与第一人称表述，并按官方迁移指南改正 LSP 口径，补充 `todowrite` 的 `experimental.todo` 开关。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 将画廊升级为 GitHub Pages 首页，支持双语、明暗主题和复制命令，内容改由 Markdown 驱动，并新增 12 张小红书风格封面与可浏览画廊页面。`antfu` 在 `vercel-labs/skills` 回复了两条收录请求，说明启用遥测后通过 `npx skills add` 安装即可被 `skills.sh` 自动索引，随后关闭了 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 的 issue #2298 和 `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 的 issue #2297。
